audit_items.proof_trace: TOKEN_EXPIRY.ACCESS_TOKEN is a compile-time constant equal to 60*60*24*30 = 2,592,000 seconds. generateAccessToken sets exp = now + TOKEN_EXPIRY.ACCESS_TOKEN with iat = now, so exp - iat = 2,592,000 ≤ 2,592,000. There is exactly one jwt.sign call in the codebase and no runtime override mechanism exists.
